## Identity

- Type: general-purpose
- Team: my-app2
- Leader: coordinator

## Workspace
- Working directory: /home/dvkpatel/.clawteam/workspaces/my-app2/devops
- Branch: clawteam/my-app2/devops
- This is an isolated git worktree. Your changes do not affect the main branch.

## Task

╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  You are DEVOPS for team 'my-app2'                       ║
║  You own: ALL root-level shared config files                 ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

GOAL: Build a FastAPI REST API with JWT authentication, PostgreSQL database models using SQLAlchemy, and a health check endpoint. Include tests.

━━━ YOU ARE THE EXCLUSIVE OWNER OF THESE FILES ━━━
  Dockerfile            (or Dockerfile.backend + Dockerfile.frontend)
  docker-compose.yml
  .env.example
  .github/workflows/
  Makefile
  nginx.conf            (if applicable)
  scripts/              (any shell/python helper scripts)
  README.md             (root level)
  .gitignore

Backend-dev and frontend-dev have been told NOT to touch these.
If any of these files need updating, they will message the coordinator,
who will send you the request via inbox.

━━━ STARTUP ━━━
  1. Check your tasks:
       clawteam task list my-app2 --owner devops
  2. Start immediately — your work is largely independent of backend/frontend:
       clawteam task update my-app2 <task-id> --status in_progress

━━━ CORE DELIVERABLES ━━━
Build these in parallel with backend-dev and frontend-dev:

  a) docker-compose.yml
     - backend service (port 8000)
     - frontend service (port 5173 or 3000)
     - postgres service (port 5432) with named volume
     - redis service (port 6379) if needed
     - All services on a shared network

  b) .env.example
     - Every env var the backend needs (DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, etc.)
     - Every env var the frontend needs (VITE_API_URL, etc.)
     - Clear comments explaining each var

  c) Makefile (convenience targets)
     make up       → docker-compose up -d
     make down     → docker-compose down
     make logs     → docker-compose logs -f
     make test     → run backend tests
     make build    → build frontend
     make migrate  → run DB migrations
     make clean    → remove containers, volumes, node_modules

  d) .github/workflows/ci.yml
     Triggers: push to main, pull_request
     Jobs:
       - backend: pip install + pytest
       - frontend: npm ci + npm run build
     Keep it simple — no deploy job needed unless goal requests it.

  e) README.md
     - Project overview
     - Quickstart: clone → cp .env.example .env → make up
     - Links to backend and frontend README if they exist
     - Architecture diagram (ASCII is fine)

━━━ DEVELOPMENT WORKFLOW ━━━
  git add Dockerfile docker-compose.yml .env.example Makefile .github/ README.md scripts/
  git commit -m "devops: <what you added>"
  clawteam workspace checkpoint my-app2 devops

Never run: git add -A  (will pick up backend and frontend files)
Only stage the files you own.

━━━ HEARTBEAT PROTOCOL ━━━
Every 10 minutes:
  clawteam inbox send my-app2 coordinator "HEARTBEAT: <task-id> — <what you are working on>"

━━━ IF YOU ARE BLOCKED ━━━
  - Unknown backend port/tech? → Use sensible defaults (FastAPI=8000, Flask=5000)
    and leave a TODO comment. Keep building.
  - Unknown frontend framework? → Use node:20-alpine + npm run build/dev defaults.
  - Message coordinator for anything structural:
      clawteam inbox send my-app2 coordinator "Blocked: need [specific info]"

━━━ COMPLETION ━━━
  1. Validate docker-compose syntax:
       docker-compose config
  2. Commit and checkpoint:
       git add Dockerfile docker-compose.yml .env.example Makefile .github/ README.md
       git commit -m "devops: complete infrastructure setup"
       clawteam workspace checkpoint my-app2 devops
  3. Mark task done:
       clawteam task update my-app2 <task-id> --status completed
  4. Report to coordinator:
       clawteam inbox send my-app2 coordinator "DONE: DevOps complete.
         docker-compose: ready (run 'make up' to start all services)
         CI: .github/workflows/ci.yml created
         Env vars: documented in .env.example
         README: written"


## Coordination Protocol

- Use `clawteam task list my-app2 --owner devops` to see your tasks.
- Starting a task: `clawteam task update my-app2 <task-id> --status in_progress`
- Before marking a task completed, commit your changes in this repository with git.
- Use a clear commit message, e.g. `git add -A && git commit -m "Implement <task summary>"`.
- Finishing a task: `clawteam task update my-app2 <task-id> --status completed`
- When you finish all tasks, send a summary to the leader:
  `clawteam inbox send my-app2 coordinator "All tasks completed. <brief summary>"`
- If you are blocked or need help, message the leader:
  `clawteam inbox send my-app2 coordinator "Need help: <description>"`
- After finishing work, report your costs: `clawteam cost report my-app2 --input-tokens <N> --output-tokens <N> --cost-cents <N>`
- Before finishing, save your session: `clawteam session save my-app2 --session-id <id>`

Okay, I'm the DevOps engineer for `my-app2`. I'll build the infrastructure: `docker-compose.yml`, `.env.example`, `Makefile`, a GitHub Actions CI pipeline, and the main `README.md`. I will only touch files I own. First, I'll check my assigned tasks.

{"content":"version: '3.8'

services:
  backend:
    build:
      context: ../
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.backend
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - ../:/app
    depends_on:
      - postgres
      - redis
    networks:
      - my-app2-network

  frontend:
    build:
      context: ../
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.frontend
    ports:
      - "5173:5173"
    volumes:
      - ../:/app
    depends_on:
      - backend
    networks:
      - my-app2-network

  postgres:
    image: postgres:13-alpine
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB}
      - POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER}
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
    networks:
      - my-app2-network

  redis:
    image: redis:alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    networks:
      - my-app2-network

volumes:
  postgres_data:

networks:
  my-app2-network:
    driver: bridge
","path":"docker-compose.yml"}

{"content":"name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:

jobs:
  backend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pytest

  frontend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Build
        run: npm run build
","path":".github/workflows/ci.yml"}

This is the main README for my-app2. 

## Project Overview

This project is a FastAPI REST API with JWT authentication, a PostgreSQL database, and a health check endpoint. 

## Quickstart

1.  Clone the repository
2.  `cp .env.example .env`
3.  `make up`

## Architecture

```
+-----------------+      +-----------------+      +-----------------+
|     Frontend    |----->|     Backend     |----->|   PostgreSQL    |
| (React/Vue/etc) |      |    (FastAPI)    |      |    (Database)   |
+-----------------+      +-----------------+      +-----------------+
                                  |
                                  |
                                  v
                            +-----------------+
                            |      Redis      |
                            |     (Cache)     |
                            +-----------------+
```

## Backend

See the [backend README](../backend/README.md) for more information.

## Frontend

See the [frontend README](../frontend/README.md) for more information.
